audit.note: control_by_id to/back on the popup view's NavContainer; the anchor id and the pressed row's ProductId travel on the events

deviations.what: one post-1.71 member is kept for the 1:1 port: Button.ariaHasPopup (since UI5 1.84) on the Open Popover button, which the sample's own view.xml carries.

Popover.fragment.xml is rebuilt as a core:FragmentDefinition and shown with client->popover_display( by_id ), anchored to the pressed button exactly as onOpenPopover's openBy(oButton) does (app 229 idiom) - so the Popover, its NavContainer, the two Pages, the List, the StandardListItem, the ObjectHeader with its two ObjectAttributes and the Text are extra against the archived PopoverNavCon.view.xml, which only holds the l:VerticalLayout and the Button. The original caches the fragment and re-opens the same instance; the port rebuilds it per press, which is why onNavToProduct's own re-anchoring is not needed.

onNavToProduct does oNavCon.to(oDetailPage) plus oDetailPage.bindElement(ctx.getPath()). Navigation is the frontend action (control_by_id, view = cs_view-popup, 'to' on navCon; onNavBack is the matching 'back'), and the element binding is folded to root-seeded fields: the pressed row's ProductId travels with the press, the backend copies that row into the D_* fields and the detail page binds them absolutely. The two ObjectAttribute texts keep their composite shape 1:1 ({WeightMeasure} {WeightUnit} and {Width} x {Depth} x {Height} {DimUnit}), only over the folded fields.

both handlers end with byId('myPopover').focus() so keyboard focus stays inside the popover after a page change. The port does not re-issue it: the popover is never re-anchored across the navigation, so focus is not taken away, and a set_focus on an already-focused popup would be a no-op round trip.
the popover keeps ariaLabelledBy="master-title" 1:1 even though no control with that id exists in the fragment - the same dangling reference the original ships.
the full mock /ProductCollection is seeded with the fields the two pages bind (ProductId, Name, ProductPicUrl, WeightMeasure, WeightUnit, Width, Depth, Height, DimUnit, Description), all 123 rows.
not yet verified in a running system: the anchored popover with a NavContainer inside it and the to/back frontend actions on the popup view.
